name: Gamecard Holdings, Inc.
summary: Gamecard Holdings, Inc. engages in gaming business. The company is involved in the issuance and sale PF pachinko prepaid cards; development and sale of IC card systems and peripheral devices for pachinko and slot machines; and sales promotion support for pachinko parlors. It sells prepaid cards, plan, develop, sell, lease, and maintain prepaid system equipment. The company was formerly known as Gamecard-Joyco Holdings,Inc. and changed its name to Gamecard Holdings, Inc. in October 2025. Gamecard Holdings, Inc. was founded in 1988 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.
